title: 3D product photography: a complete series of equipment with integrated software
h1: 3D product photography: a complete series of equipment with integrated software
description: Complete 3D product photography solutions: PackshotSphere X5, MacroSphere and interactive HTML5 spherical animations to boost your e-commerce conversions.
content:
We offer a complete series of equipment with integrated software that allows users to easily develop 3D product animations in spherical or hemispherical mode. Our systems combine one or more cameras with a 360 turntable and software. The software controls and synchronizes the cameras and the turntable, automating and facilitating the creation of 3D product views. Perfect for communicating the quality or value of a product !

Stand out from the competition

PROVIDE CREATIVE AND UNIQUE 3D PRODUCT ANIMATIONS

  • In-house – An easy-to-use software workflow allows any team member to develop fully spherical and hemispherical 360° product animations, regardless of their experience.
  • Fast and simple – Quickly create web-ready 3D product views in just a few minutes.
  • Detailed visuals – Customers won't miss any detail ! Add deep zoom to the 3D animations to display all the important details of your products.
  • Flexible & convenient – Photograph and export individual files in JPG, PNG, TIFF, or RAW formats and/or import them into the PackshotCreator software to create 360° and 3D animations.
  • Attractive product views – Interactive 3D product animations increase conversion rates in online sales and allow companies to better communicate about their products.
  • Save, host and share – Automatically create spherical and hemispherical animations and upload them to the web instantly. Discover how to host your product photographs in the Cloud

3D product animations with multiple cameras

Easily create spherical or hemispherical animations in just a few minutes ! Our 3D product photo solutions and dynamic software guarantee the fastest and most productive workflow possible. When the PackshotSphere X5 is paired with a turntable from the PackshotSpin range, the integrated software synchronizes the shooting (up to 10 cameras) and the movement of the turntable to automate the 3D creation process. Both systems are controlled simultaneously on the same screen. Once calibrated, these 3D systems do not require any necessary handling.

The captured photos can be exported simply or automatically assembled automatically into interactive 3D product animations. Users have the ability to fully customize them by adding buttons, a deep zoom, hyperlinks, and much more.

3D systems

We manufacture 3D product photography solutions, including professional LED lighting, 360 turntables and multiple camera arms to photograph products of all sizes. Our patented turntables and LED lighting environments are entirely software-controlled, which simplifies shooting products on a pure white or transparent background, whatever the angle. Our 3D systems ensure high throughput, consistent results and exceptional image quality.

3D software

We have developed special software features and production workflows to boost productivity and facilitate the creation of 3D product animations. Speed up shooting and improve photo consistency by saving and reusing the best settings. Every setting present in the PackshotCreator software can be saved and reused over time.

More essential features of the 3D software:

  • Take up to 1024 images across 10 rows
  • Control up to 10 cameras at the same time
  • Simultaneously manage different 3D equipment, turntables and photo studios from the same software
  • Memorize the position of products by saving ghost images. Then reapply them to increase the consistency of your animations
  • Quickly take 3D product views on a pure white background
  • Easily create 3D animations on a clipped background
  • Develop spherical and hemispherical animations in just a few minutes
  • Formats available for all web platforms and media: JPG, PNG, TIFF, RAW, HTML5, GIF, MOV, MP4
  • Batch editing, cropping, assembly and export
  • Simple to learn and use. No experience required.
Discover other software advantages

3D product photography with one or two cameras

MacroSphere

The MacroSphere can be combined with a PackshotMacro DL, PackshotMacro DIS orPackshotMacro RE to photograph jewelry and other small-sized products. This 3D rail not only allows you to find the best angle for 2D and 360 views, but also to capture and assemble interactive spherical and hemispherical product animations.

PackshotDual Capture

The PackshotDual Capture works with all PackshotCreator solutions that have a turntable to create interactive two-row 3D views of products of all sizes. Two-row product views are more flexible and offer potential customers more information than a classic 360° animation.A perfect combination.

A perfect combination: 360° /3D photo studio and software

Combine our 3D equipment with a turntable or a 360° photo studio to create not only 3D animations, but also 2D photos, multi-views and 360° animations and videos of all products. Control these solutions simultaneously from the same software. View and use unique software features such as LightControl, the clipping features AutoPNG, AutoBKG and AutoMask, the Custom Defined, and others in real time on the same screen.

Interactive 3D product animations

Increase your website's conversion rate: offer visitors interactive 3D product animations. Our software allows users to fully customize their spherical and hemispherical animations by adding buttons, zooms, hyperlinks and by setting the speed, movement and much more. These interactive animations can then be uploaded to the web and are compatible with all media for viewing on Android, Mac and PC smartphones and tablets.

Learn more about 360° product animations in HTML5 format

Complete automation

Whether you create visuals for quality control, archiving, product identification or e-commerce, our solutions and our product photography software automate the entire creation process. The software guides the user in placing products and simplifies shooting, multiple retouching, processing and saving. The settings are saved and reused to increase productivity and consistency.
